stem: What does the conversation between Charlie Joe and his parents in paragraphs 26 through 30 suggest?

options.label: A
options.text: Charlie Joe thinks that being able to avoid going to summer camp will be an easy task.

options.label: B
options.text: Charlie Joe's mother believes that the summer camp will not offer any benefit to Charlie Joe.

options.label: C
options.text: Charlie Joe feels inspired to do better in school because of his parents' faith in his abilities.

options.label: D
options.text: Charlie Joe's father doubts that Charlie Joe will be able to achieve the goal he has set for himself.
